label: Kind of regiment
summary: Whether the men-at-arms regiment is of the given men-at-arms type.
details: Write the type's name, for example `light_footmen`. Vanilla uses it with types such as cataphract, crossbowmen, bowmen and armored_horsemen.

label: Is male
summary: Whether the character is male.
details: `yes` passes for male characters, `no` for female ones.

label: Manual participant
summary: Whether the given character counts as a manual participant candidate in this situation.
details: Works on a situation. Vanilla gives it a character reference (`prev`). The game does not explain what a manual participant is beyond this.

label: Is married
summary: Whether the character is married.
details: `yes` passes for married characters, `no` for unmarried ones.

label: Member of confederation
summary: Whether the character belongs to the given confederation.
details: Write a confederation. Vanilla passes the confederation of a character, such as `scope:actor.confederation`.

label: Memory of travel
summary: Whether the memory is about the given travel plan.
details: Works on a character memory. Vanilla uses it once, with the current travel plan of the root character.

label: Is mercenary company
summary: Whether the title is a mercenary company.
details: Works on a title. `yes` passes for mercenary company titles, `no` for all others.

label: Mercenary in hire range
summary: Whether the mercenary company is within the hiring range of the given character.
details: The range is measured for the given character. The input names no scope for it; going by the game's documentation it is used on a mercenary company. Vanilla uses it twice, with `root`.

label: Is migrating
summary: Whether the character is currently migrating.
details: `yes` passes while the character is on a migration, `no` when not.

label: Is migration target
summary: Whether a migration is aimed at this title, at a title above it, or at one below it.
details: It checks the de jure lieges (the titles it belongs to) and the de jure vassals (the titles that belong to it) as well, so a migration into any county of the title counts. Works on a title.

label: Is military order
summary: Whether the holy order is a military one.
details: Works on a holy order. The game's own example is `scope:holy_order = { is_military_order = yes }`. Vanilla scripts do not use it.

label: Borders realm of
summary: Whether the title lies next to the realm of the given character.
details: Works on a title, and the character is the one whose realm is checked. Vanilla passes characters such as `root` or `scope:actor`.

label: Nibling of
summary: Whether the character is a niece or nephew of the given character.
details: Nibling is a gender-neutral word for niece or nephew. The character in the block is the niece or nephew, the written character is the aunt or uncle.

label: No-men cheat on
summary: Whether the character is the player and the game's "no men" cheat is switched on.
details: The game does not say what the cheat does. No vanilla script uses this trigger.

label: Noble family title
summary: Whether the title is one that noble families use so that a landless character can be playable.
details: Works on a title. Vanilla checks it often, with both `yes` and `no`.

label: Nomad title
summary: Whether the title is one that nomads use so that a landless character can be playable.
details: Works on a title. Compare is_noble_family_title, which is the same idea for noble families.

label: Is regular councillor
summary: Whether the character is a regular councillor.
details: The game does not say which councillors count as not regular. Vanilla uses it six times.

label: Is obedient
summary: Whether the character is obedient.
details: `yes` passes for obedient characters, `no` for others. For obedience towards one specific person use is_obedient_to.

label: Obedient to
summary: Whether the character is obedient to the given character.
details: The character in the block is the one who obeys, the written character is the one obeyed. Vanilla mostly passes `root`.

label: Is occupied
summary: Whether the province is currently occupied.
details: Works on a province. `yes` passes for occupied provinces, `no` for others.

label: Open invite activity
summary: Whether the activity is an open invite activity.
details: Works on an activity. Vanilla uses it once, with `yes`.

label: Opposite of trait
summary: Whether the trait is an opposite of the given trait.
details: Works on a trait. Write the other trait, for example `scope:trait`. Vanilla scripts do not use it.

label: Overrides designated winner
summary: Whether the character, pledged to a great holy war, overrides the designated winner of that war.
details: If the character is the top participant, their beneficiary is put on the throne. Vanilla uses it once, with `yes`.

label: Is papabile
summary: Whether the character is a current candidate in the elective succession of their clerical or theocratic faith.
details: It reads the same list of candidates that the College of Cardinals window shows. Vanilla uses it three times, with `yes`.

label: Parent of
summary: Whether the character is a parent of the given character.
details: The character in the block is the parent, the written character the child.

label: Is war participant
summary: Whether the given character takes part in the war, as attacker or defender.
details: Works on a war. The written character is the one checked.

label: Takes part in activity
summary: Whether the character is a participant in the given activity.
details: The character in the block is the one checked. Vanilla mostly passes `scope:activity`.

label: Takes part in war
summary: Whether the character takes part in the given war, as attacker or defender.
details: The character in the block is the one checked. For the reverse form, on the war, use is_participant.

label: Is paused
summary: Whether the travel plan is paused.
details: Works on a travel plan. Vanilla uses it with `yes` only.

label: Perfect accolade successor
summary: Whether the character is a perfect fit to take over as successor of the given accolade.
details: Write the accolade. The game does not explain what makes a fit perfect. Vanilla scripts do not use it.

label: Performs council task
summary: Whether the character is performing exactly the given council task.
details: Write the task's name, for example `task_conversion`. Copies of a task do not count. For those use is_performing_council_task_or_clone.

label: Performs task or copy
summary: Whether the character is performing the given council task or a copy of it.
details: The game's example: asking for `task_kurultai_fertility_1` also passes when the character performs `task_kurultai_fertility_2`.

label: Personal regiment
summary: Whether the men-at-arms regiment is a personal one.
details: Works on a regiment. The game does not say what makes a regiment personal. Vanilla uses it five times, with `yes`.

label: Plans great project
summary: Whether the character is currently planning the given great project.
details: Write the project's key, for example `great_wall`. The game says the check fails if the planner or the project type is invalid.

label: Player heir of
summary: Whether the character is the player heir of the given character.
details: The character in the block is the heir, the written character is the one they would inherit from.

label: Player has character
summary: Whether the player is currently playing a character.
details: It is an interface trigger: the game allows it only in specific places, such as the user interface.

label: Tutorial character
summary: Whether the player is a tutorial character.
details: Vanilla uses it ten times, always with `no`.

label: Pledged GHW attacker
summary: Whether the character is a pledged attacker in the current great holy war.
details: It is an error to check this when no great holy war is going on.

label: Is in the pool
summary: Whether the character is in the pool, meaning not a ruler and not a courtier or guest at any court.
details: `no` passes for characters who have a place at a court or rule themselves.

label: Is pool guest
summary: Whether the character is a guest who comes from the pool.
details: Unlike is_foreign_court_guest, a pool guest has no liege.
